name: claude-token-stack
description: Cross-platform Claude Code token governance kit with hooks, policies, validation, and benchmarks.
author: Claude Token Stack Contributors

scripts.check:shell: bash -n bin/install-claude-token-stack.sh && bash -n bin/verify-claude-token-stack.sh && bash -n bin/run-token-benchmark.sh && bash -n bin/cts-run-agent-unattended.sh
scripts.check:templates: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const files=['templates/.mcp.local.example.json','templates/.claude/settings.json','templates/.claude/token-policy.md','templates/.claude/hooks/run-python-hook.js','templates/.claude/hooks/bash-token-guard.py','templates/.claude/hooks/cbm-gate.py','templates/.claude/output-styles/token-lean.md','templates/docs/claude-token-stack.md','templates/docs/claude-token-stack-rollback.md','templates/docs/context-pack-template.md','templates/docs/mcp-local-smoke.md']; for (const f of files) { if (!fs.existsSync(f)) throw new Error(f+' missing'); } JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('templates/.claude/settings.json','utf8')); JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('templates/.mcp.local.example.json','utf8'));"
scripts.lint: npm run check:node && npm run check:python && npm run check:shell && npm run check:templates
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:hooks && npm run test:helpers && node bin/cts.js scaffold --target .tmp/verify-fixture && npm run verify
